description: The Artifactory server is running low on disk space. Your task is to identify all artifacts in the 'example-repo-local' repository that are larger than 5 MB (5,242,880 bytes). Download these specific large files to a new local directory at '/home/ga/large_files_backup'. Additionally, create a text file named 'manifest.txt' in that same directory listing the filenames of the backed-up artifacts (one per line). Do not delete the files from the repository, just copy them locally. Exclude any files smaller than 5 MB.
